reason: Both reach the correct "no, fix the pipeline" answer and give similar remedies. B covers more of the key points. It names Shopify and GitHub as precedent, and it frames Packwerk or engines as the modular-monolith answer to code coupling. It puts CI speed first, and it tells the asker to measure where the queue time goes. A has a useful flaky-test caveat and a team-size threshold, but it names no precedent companies and treats Packwerk mainly as selective CI.
